meta.name: paperclip-create-agent
meta.description: Create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring. Use when you need to inspect adapter configuration options, compare existing agent configs, draft a new agent prompt/config, and submit a hire request.

copy.tagline: 在 Paperclip 中创建并提交新 agent 的 hire 请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Paperclip 平台中创建新 agent 并走审批流程。
copy.tagline_en: Create and submit hire requests for new agents in Paperclip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你创建新的 Paperclip 智能体。它会检查你的权限，获取适配器配置，对比现有智能体配置，起草新智能体的提示词和设置，最后提交雇佣请求。
howto.when: 当你要求雇佣或创建一个新的 Paperclip 智能体时触发。需要 Paperclip 已安装运行，并且你有董事会权限或公司授予的创建智能体权限。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 CTO 智能体。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行雇佣流程，检查权限并收集配置。

say.text: 查看当前可用的智能体图标列表。
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 获取图标列表供你选择。

say.text: 提交一个后端工程师智能体的雇佣请求。
say.note: Claude 会起草配置并提交审批。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create new Paperclip agents. It checks your permissions, fetches adapter configurations, compares existing agent configs, drafts the new agent's prompt and settings, and submits a hire request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to hire or create a new Paperclip agent. Requires Paperclip to be installed and running, and you must have board access or agent creation permission.

say_en.text: Create a new CTO agent for me.
Show me the list of available agent icons.
say_en.note: Claude will call the API to fetch the icon list for you to choose from.

say_en.text: Submit a hire request for a backend engineer agent.
say_en.note: Claude will draft the configuration and submit it for approval.
